sermon.title: Does Jesus Want Us to Repent?  What Does He Say?
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: A short teaching: repentance is changing your mind and behavior about sin. John and Jesus preached it, the kingdom of God is near and within you, and God commands all men everywhere to repent before the day of judgment.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. scriptures.text_nkjv: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching a baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

Therefore bear fruits worthy of repentance, and do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I say to you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.
Draw near to God and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
From that time Jesus began to preach and to say, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.”

chunks.section_question: Where is the kingdom of God?
chunks.short_answer: Near you and within you: righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Spirit. God now commands all men everywhere to repent.
chunks.text: God has come near you you don’t have to fly somewhere you don’t have to be of a certain race the kingdom of God is available to you it’s at hand it’s near you in Luke chapter 17 verse 21 Jesus says the kingdom of God does not come with observation it’s not something you can find at the store it’s not something you can travel to see he says the kingdom of God is within you and Romans chapter 14:17 the kingdom of God is not eating or drinking but righteousness peace and joy in the Holy Spirit in Matthew 3:11 John reminds us that Jesus Christ will baptize us with the Holy Spirit and fire in Luke chapter 12 verse 5 Jesus said fear him who has the power to cast into hell yes I say to you fear him Jesus Christ will judge the world in Acts chapter 17 verse 30 it says truly these times of ignorance God overlooked but now commands all men everywhere to repent because he has appointed a day on which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man Jesus Christ.

scriptures.text_nkjv: ‘The very dust of your city which clings to us we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that the kingdom of God has come near you.’
nor will they say, ‘See here!’ or ‘See there!’ For indeed, the kingdom of God is within you.”
for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance, but He who is coming after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear Him who, after He has killed, has power to cast into hell; yes, I say to you, fear Him!

Truly, these times of ignorance God overlooked, but now commands all men everywhere to repent, because He has appointed a day on which He will judge the world in righteousness by the Man whom He has ordained. He has given assurance of this to all by raising Him from the dead.”

chunks.short_answer: Yes—it is time to repent from our wicked ways, humble ourselves in prayer and follow Jesus Christ, the key to eternal life.
chunks.text: And so do we care if Christ is offended by our sins. Do we care about pleasing and honoring Jesus Christ are we willing to repent by changing our minds and our sinful behaviors I submit to you today it is time for us to repent from our wicked ways it is time for us to humble ourselves in prayer to God it is time for us to follow the key to eternal life that is Jesus Christ. You.

faqs.question: What does repentance change?
faqs.answer: Your mind and your behavior toward sin.

faqs.question: What did John say to bear?
What does James promise?
faqs.answer: Draw near to God and He will draw near to you.

faqs.question: Did Jesus preach repentance?
faqs.answer: Yes, from the start of His ministry.

faqs.question: Must you travel to find the kingdom?
Whom did Jesus say to fear?
faqs.answer: Him who has power to cast into hell.

faqs.question: Who will judge the world?
faqs.answer: God, by the man Jesus Christ.

faqs.question: What question does the speaker ask?
faqs.answer: Do we care if Christ is offended by our sins?
